articleTitle: Absolute Randomness as a Key Part of Information Security
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: The paper describes a technology for sending and assembling data packets based on a random selection of servers. It is this approach that avoids a lot of problems in the field of information security. The given solution is considered for an abstract industry, and can be adapted to any needs. In the final part of the article, a description of the software solution developed for the implementation of this technology is presented.

articleTitle: Development of an Optical Dental Recognition Subsystem in an Antropomorphic Simulator
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: Our group is developing a simulator which is a dental anthropomorphic robot that would allow an objective assessment of the student’s manual skills using the case system. In addition to practical exercises, the simulator allows you to study the theoretical aspects of the disciplines, is able to conduct surveys on the topics of practical classes and lectures, and evaluate test tasks due to the interactive component. The base of the simulator is the optical recognition system which checks the correctness of student’s results.

articleTitle: Methodology for Training Data Science Skills Based on Competitions on the Kaggle Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: The article describes the experience of teaching students of Big Data analytics-related fields the basics of data science. The teaching methodology used at the Financial University under the Government of the Russian Federation is given, which consists in involvement of students of the group to competitions on Google Kaggle platform. In this methodology, the positive factors influencing the rapid acquisition of initial data science skills are: competitive effect; availability of prepared datasets and problem formulations from the real business sector in various directions; possibility of instant verification of the found solution; practical unlimited number of solutions. These factors contribute to the rapid understanding by students of the need to understand the essence of the problem for the best results, obligatory familiarization with the data, data cleaning and formatting, exploratory data analysis, forming a model with some basic level and its improvement, as well as interpretation.

articleTitle: Using GPUs and CUDA for Computer Simulation of Rigid Bodies Motion
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: The article discusses the use of parallel programming, GPUs and CUDA architecture to accelerate computations in rigid-body dynamics modeling problems. Such modeling can be used to consider technically complex systems, prior to their production and testing, in order to reduce the price of these systems and the time spent. The working principles of NVIDIA Tesla Series GPUs are discussed in detail, as well as the features of programming using Compute Unified Device Architecture (CUDA) of the same company. The concept of modeling dynamics of rigid bodies using paralleling is also presented. This concept is represented schematically, it calculates the position of a body from its initial state, using time integration, at the same time detecting collisions between rigid bodies and reacting to them by pushing these bodies away from each other.

articleTitle: Decision Support System for Scientific and Technical Expertise
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: Currently in the Russian Federation the state actively supports IT companies that are engaged in research and development work (R&D) as part of the implementation of the state program to create a digital economy. One of the forms of state support for IT companies is the provision of tax benefits to them. In this regard a very important process of verifying the validity of the provision of tax benefits is the examination of scientific and technical documentation provided by IT companies to the tax authorities. The paper considers the issues of creating a support system for conducting scientific and technical examinations of materials submitted by IT companies to confirm the correctness of classifying the work performed as R&D. In this article, we offer the specialized software named Support System which allows taxpayers to provide information about completed R&D projects in a checklist format in a declarative manner. Criteria for compliance of implemented IT projects with R&D projects are defined. The reporting documentation undergoes a multi-stage check in accordance with the developed algorithms for loading and analyzing text materials for compliance with the established criteria. The adequacy of used algorithms is confirmed by the results of computer simulation. The developed prototype of the support system for conducting scientific and technical examinations is planned to be introduced into the activities of tax inspections.

articleTitle: Fast Launch of Web Applications Based on Microservice Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: This article describes a way to fast launch web applications on a microservices architecture. The focus is on solving the problem of scaling and organizing web application development for small and medium-sized organizations. The goal of this paper is to create an understandable, simple, user-friendly, and flexible template for designing, making, and maintaining web applications. During this work, the selection of an appropriate stack of modern tools for web development was carried out. Principles for ensuring parallel work of several developers were applied. Clean Architecture approaches are used. Implemented a pluggable mechanism for user authentication. Necessary source code repositories were created on GitHub. Published auxiliary libraries in PHP and JavaScript. Several web applications were created and deployed using this method. In summary, a development template has been created that is suitable for fast launch of web applications and provides convenient team-based development and scalability.

articleTitle: The Problem of Preserving the Governing Equations’ Structure in Computer Simulation of Fluid Flow
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: Real time fluid animation remains challenging interesting area of research because of a number of problems that vary from high computational cost of the simulation to numerical viscosity. In this paper we mostly focus on the problem of saving the structure of determining equations. Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) is mostly based on the use of incompressible Navier-Stokes equations, however, when it comes to visual component, the use of Eulerian schemes is more advantageous. Lagrangian schemes also can be used, but it’s hard to implement them efficiently. Either way methods require further adjustments to prevent energy dissipation, and preserve kinetic energy in time, total enstrophy and time reversibility. Approaching the solution of the problem, we consider the full-Euler schemes that do not depend on grid size or spatial sampling of a simulation which are yet to be explored in modeling.

articleTitle: Comparing Prospective King AV1 Codec with Current Best Alternative HEVC in Different Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: High Efficiency Video Coding is a mature, well known and widely supported non-free video codec first published in 2013. AOMedia Video 1 is a royalty free coding format designed for video transmissions over the Internet. It was first published in 2018 and is slowly but surely growing in popularity. My goal is to study the latest revisions of the most popular AV1 and HEVC encoders to find out which gives better compression, in what scenarios, how compute hungry an algorithm is. Key testing points are target quality (CRF and/or QP) efficiency, average perceptual video quality for bitrate, possible bitrate saving for increased encoding time, compression strength on various common resolutions, real-time encoding and how good it is, multithreading capabilities of encoders. The core quality determent metric is VMAF, which is rather popular and trustworthy in the encoding community.

articleTitle: QR Code Authentication System as an Ultimate Tool for Personal Cybersecurity
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: According to various research, the human factor plays a drastic part in cybersecurity concerns as people tend to be negligent towards their personal data and credentials. The article analyzes some of the existing authentication methods and proposes one of the possible solutions to this problem – a universal proxy service that handles credentials and securely delivers these on-demand via QR (Quick Response) code system. This software splits into three parts: mobile application (password manager), web application, and developer tool for third-party integration. This article is an extended version of a previous one “Development of QR-code Authentication Software as Internet-Service”

articleTitle: Intelligent Analysis of Big Data in the Information Flow
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: The article considers the use of AI methods for creation of a knowledge base in the field of recreation using a national interactive map of local cultural trends. The map contains thousands of brands classified into 9 categories covering all the regions of the country.

articleTitle: Development of a Unified Map of the Region Using AI Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: This paper presents, the algorithms of implementation of a unified regional map, which includes the function of independent addition of regional sites of interest through artificial intelligence technology, as well as the function of automatic generation of recreation routes based on user preferences.

articleTitle: Regarding the Stability Assessment of the Informatization Object under the Conditions of Computer Attacks at the Exponential Distribution Law of Time to an Enemy Impact
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: The aim of the study is to develop a mathematical model for assessing the informatization object (IO) stability functioning under the conditions of computer attacks (CA). The problem formulation differs from the known ones in that to describe the IO state, the concept of an “irrevocable state” is introduced, into which the IO may pass when the restoration resource is exhausted. A mathematical model has been developed that makes it possible to construct the IO stability function taking into account the intensities of the CA flows and recoveries, taking into account resource constraints. Quantitative IO stability assessment is in demand by information security (IS) management bodies when providing IS, conducting an IS audit and justifying the requirements for the IO operability restoring system after successful CA.

articleTitle: Problems of Trajectory Planning in Manipulators with Parallel Kinematics
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: This paper considers the problems of trajectory planning in manipulators with complex parallel kinematics, for example Delta mechanism and five-link manipulator. The main advantage of parallel kninematics robots is being widely used for precise applications to achieve complex motions and variable poses for the end effector tool. Application of these robots is widespread in areas such as medicine and the electronics industry. Parallel manipulators have better stiffness and dynamic characteristics than manipulators with sequential kinematics. Firstly, the application of manipulators of this type in various fields of science and technology, as well as their advantages and disadvantages, are considered. Secondly, an analysis of the Zlatanov taxonomy is made, and some types of singularities are considered. Thirdly, possible ways of solving problems of parallel kinematic manipulator are indicated. Fourthly, the issue of trajectory planning simulation and implementation of hardware and software are most major field for research in this article. Finally, we discuss promising research directions for solving trajectory planning problems for manipulators of complex kinematics, electronic industry and industry 4.0, industry 5.0.

articleTitle: Development of an Automated Information System for the IT Clinic
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: Nowadays, modern universities organise units in which students of IT can obtain additional practical skills in IT during extracurricular time. Most often, their work is organized according to the clinic principle and, accordingly, requires various types of accounting and analytics. This paper deals with the development of an automated information system for the needs of IT clinic of Admiral Makarov State University of Maritime and Inland Shipping.

Author Keywords: Admiral Makarov State University of Maritime and Inland Shipping

articleTitle: Unsupervised Texture Image Segmentation Based on Local Features
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: The article is devoted to the problem of unsupervised segmentation of texture images. Texture segmentation can be used in the analysis of satellite, geological, medical, biological images. Texture segmentation algorithms have many advantages: lightness, speed, the possibility of unsupervised implementation, simpleness of automatic labeling of data sets, a set of target tasks. Model with the following steps was chosen to solution. After a simple pre-processing of the raw image, the local vector texture characteristics of the each point of the image are calculated. For this goal used a bank of convolutional Gabor filters and empirical curvelet filters that produce frequency splitting. Computed local histogram aggregation. Then, clustering is performed based on the construction of a feature matrix and singular decomposition. All levels of segmentation automation up to fully automatic have been explored. All algorithms are implemented and tested on prepared synthetic and real data.

articleTitle: Myanmar Sports Sub-News Categorization Using Chi-Square, Bag of Words, and Cosine Similarity Combining with Smooth TF-IDF
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: In recent years, text news, unstructured data, are rapidly growing over the Internet. To automatically categorize and organize text news, text classification is used. It is applied in topic labeling, spam detection, and sentiment analysis. This paper proposes a hybrid method for automatic Myanmar sports sub-news categorization. Myanmar sports news has been categorized into 19 sports sub-news categories by combining Chi-Square and bag of words (BOW) based system and the term frequency-inverse document frequency (TF-IDF) based system. The classification method used for the systems is cosine similarity. The experimental results showed that the hybrid approach achieved better accuracy (98.85%) than the separated approaches (Chi-Square and BOW based system 96.18% and TF-IDF based system 93.13%) without hybridization.

articleTitle: Scientific Gamification of Students in the Study of Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: The paper reviews the computer game devoted to learning AI technologies. The concept, contents, objective of forming the knowledge of artificial intelligence with the coming bachelor’s in applied information science are provided. It is established that improvement of student training is essential to create a specialist capable of working with AI technologies and creating digital products in order to carry out the tasks set by the society.

articleTitle: Real-Time Simulation of Quadrocopter Motion for Virtual Test Site
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: This article describes the problem of simulating the movement of a quadcopter in a virtual environment system. The proposed solution to this problem includes the construction of a virtual polygon and the implementation of various flight modes of a virtual quadcopter in the cross-platform development environment Unity. To do this, we consider a mathematical model of the dynamics of the quadcopter, consisting of a kinematic model based on Newton’s law, and a dynamic model based on Euler’s law. The described approach to modeling the control system makes it possible to evaluate the control system of the quadcopter and reproduce the dynamics of flight of a real physical object.

articleTitle: Application Encryption with Trusted Platform Module to Implement Standards in Windows 11 Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: Trusted Platform Module (further TPM) was conceived as a low-cost chip that was first integrated into the processor and then became part of the motherboard. The controller works like a micro-computer. It accepts commands, responds to them, and also stores and issues information. The functionality of TPM is focused on user security: if an application entrusts a TPM password, then the module can make this password available only to the process where it was originally stored; the module is able to evaluate the state of the hardware configuration and enter the software running on the PC, determining the safety of a familiar environment. TPM can store file data both in its original form and encrypted using public key cryptography, and is also capable of creating signatures.

articleTitle: Development of an Automated Scheduling System Using Neural Network Technologies and Sorting Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: This article offers a solution to the problem of optimizing the time-resource ratio using neural network algorithms and a multidimensional knapsack. By implementing the knapsack sorting, optimal time and energy activities are selected, and the neural network fills in the free intervals based on the entered parameters. The ultimate goal of the «Scheduling automation system» is to increase efficiency, reduce energy consumption of the final user.

articleTitle: The Problem of Ensuring the Information Security of Robots in the Implementation of the Laws of Robotics
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: The laws of robotics were created to protect a person from the potentially dangerous actions of a robot with artificial intelligence with the ability to think. However, the ideal model of such a robot has not yet been created, which is why the laws are only partially implemented in practice. This was achieved through significant advances in the field of artificial intelligence training. The trend shows that robots are gradually approaching the acquisition of a simplified creation, which will allow the full implementation of the laws of robotics. This leads to the emergence of the problem of ensuring information security, since robots are considered from the point of view of an object, and the presence of consciousness makes them subjects. This article formulates the problem of the influence of the duality of the perception of the object- subject on the information security of the robot and puts forward a hypothesis for its solution.

articleTitle: Strategies and Methods of Overcoming Threats to Information Security in Social Educational Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: The article analyzes the didactic potential of using social networks as components of electronic information and educational systems of educational institutions. It is noted that social educational networks are increasingly subject to hacking attacks and are a source of information security threats. It is given the nomenclature of potential threats, as well as their characteristics. It is proposed a set of protection methods against threats that can be undertaken individually by the technical services of educational institutions. The advantages and disadvantages of each method are considered. They are given the examples of software products which use would reduce the risks of information security in social networks. Most of these tools are currently either little known or not available on the market. The creation and development of such products is supposed a promising task.

articleTitle: Developing a Program for the Digital Learning Environment of Higher Education: Text Recognition Using the Tesseract Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: This article presents a program for the digital learning environment of universities: text recognition developed using the Tesseract artificial intelligence technology. An algorithm for recognizing text from pictures, photographs and drawings is presented. This development is implemented and used on the GPAYALTA Portal.

articleTitle: Vulnerability Analysis of Electronic Voting Protocols
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: Electronic voting is a complex but widely demanded technology. The generally accepted opinion is that electronic voting guarantees the anonymity of voters and at the same time allows verify the correctness of registration of votes, ensuring transparency of the electoral process. Attempts to use electronic voting technologies in elections began a long time ago, but, as practice has shown, it has not yet been possible to create a secure system that meets all the election principles. This article analyzes the shortcomings and vulnerabilities of online election systems used in various countries. We consider the methods of protecting the electronic voting process based on an additively homomorphic Shamir secret sharing scheme, which allows voters to jointly calculate the results of voting, operating with encrypted ballots without revealing their own vote.

articleTitle: Software for Presenting a Scientist’s Personal Brand
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: A software for automatic generation of a digital portfolio of a scientist is proposed. The Python software provides personal science brand infographic design with dynamic database support, user-friendly interface, and no system programming knowledge required. Digital portfolio toolkit allows to demonstrate text, graphics and video information The software product can be successfully applied in science management processes using digital tools. Besides, it might be a real advantage for a scientists, especially for those participating in frontier grant

articleTitle: Intelligent Docker Container Orchestration for Low Scheduling Latency and Fast Migration in Paas
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: Most modern cloud Platform as a Service (PaaS) systems are built on the basis of application containerization technology. The containerization schedulers currently in use do not have intelligent algorithms for placing containers across nodes. They work on the principle of placing in the “first suitable slot”. This article discusses two issues related to intelligent decision-making about moving containers between servers: the lethality of obtaining metrics for monitoring the current state of the platform and taking into account the influence of container deployment parameters on the speed of transformations. The article proposes a way to determine the necessary and sufficient number of monitoring services for latency management. The paper also considers the influence of microservices launch parameters, the size of the container image on the time of transferring the container between nodes, and proposes a model for assessing the complexity of transferring containers between nodes.

articleTitle: Zero-Knowledge Proof and its Application in Distributed Registry Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: Existing distributed ledger systems ensure the integrity and availability of information, but they lack built-in mechanisms to ensure the confidentiality of transaction data recorded in the ledger. Any intruder can obtain all transaction data by downloading a copy of the ledger and trace the relationships between transactions and accounts. Thus, additional mechanisms are needed to ensure the confidentiality of transactions. One solution to this problem is to use a zero-knowledge proof protocol. This article discusses the use of zero-knowledge proof to ensure the confidentiality of transactions in distributed ledger systems. We consider both the UTXO-model and the account model.

articleTitle: Creation of a Hardware-Software Complex for Controlling a Five-Link Robotic Manipulator
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: The paper presents results of research and development of an application for controlling a five-link flat manipulator. Analysis of possible solution methods was carried out, and the PyQt5 library was selected for the implementation of the application. As a result, an application was created that meets all the requirements set for the developer. The paper also presents the developers experience that can be helpful to novice specialists.

articleTitle: Spectral Investigation of Pseudo-Random Sequences: Token Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: The paper discusses graphical research methods of stochastic transformations. The modified methods for detecting anomalies, patterns and deviations in pseudorandom sequences are Described. Spectral tests for assessing the quality of stochastic transformations are presented. Proofs of correctness of the described methods are given. The results of PRNG research with proposed methods are presented. The recommendations to increase the effectiveness of proposed investigation methods are formulated.

articleTitle: Develompent and Study of Stochastic Algorithms for Lightweight Devices Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: This research article is devoted to the modification of existing stochastic algorithms in order to use them in lightweight devices. The facilitation approaches for block algorithms and their primitives are considered. Various tests for evaluation of properties of pseudo-random sequences of lightweight devices are also proposed. The results of studies of the statistical properties of the developed lightweight algorithms are presented.

articleTitle: Side-channel Attacks Protection for the GOST 34.12-2018 "Grasshopper" Algorithm Using Isomorphism in Finite Fields
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: Information security algorithms can be flawless in theory, but it can be vulnerable to attacks aimed at their physical implementation - side-channel attacks. In this paper, the method of protection against such attacks is considered on the example of the algorithm GOST 34.12-2018 "Grasshopper". The “Grasshopper” algorithm, like some others, uses finite field arithmetic for linear transformation. The protection method we are considering is based on the isomorphism of finite fields. Isomorphism allows to keep the results of the algorithm unchanged, but modify the information transmitted through side channels. Protection does not complicate the implementation of the algorithm and does not require additional computing resources. Hardware and software implementations of the method are considered.

articleTitle: Solving Agent Initialization Problems in a Multi-Agent System
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: The development of multi-agent systems has had an enormous impact on various areas of life. The essence of multi-agent systems is to solve problems that are difficult or impossible to solve with a single agent or with classical mathematical methods. However, there are many problems associated with the use of multi-agent systems, such as formation management. This paper focuses on formation control problems, where the main problem is the problem of initialization of agents at the initial moment of time in various formation control problems. The main ambiguities of formation are described, and their solutions in the initialization of agents are described. It is shown that graph theory minimizes computational processes of interaction between agents in decentralized control.

articleTitle: Data Collection with Esp32 Microcontroller for Training Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: The paper discusses the prototyping of a system based on the Esp32 microcontroller and a Php web server. The microcontroller collects data from humidity and temperature sensors, and then transmits it via a Wi-fi network and a Post request to a Php server. Further processing and storage of data takes place on the Web server. The server writes the received data to a csv file, and also can display the received information in the form of a dynamic table. A similar system can be used to create datasets that are used for training neural networks.

articleTitle: Advantages and Disadvantages of Spiking Neural Networks Compared to Classical Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) are a parallel branch of the development of artificial neural networks (ANNs) and SNNs are obviously significantly different from ANNs. In SNNs, unlike ANNs, information transmitted from neuron to neuron is an object that corresponds to a nerve impulse in the brain, in other words, a spike transmitted between neurons through synaptic communication. The functioning of the neuron in this case manifests itself only as the generation of spikes. Research shows that SNNs can work with single-bit signals with virtually no loss of accuracy. SNNs promise prospects that force such giants as IBM and Intel to create their research processors on the SNNs system. However, advantages also entail disadvantages - for example, there is still no final solution to the problem of how to train SNNs. The article reveals the advantages and disadvantages of spiking neural networks in comparison with classical artificial neural networks.

Author Keywords: advantages and disadvantages of spiking neural networks

articleTitle: Problems of Physically Plausible Simulation of the Motion of Mechanical Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: In this paper, the problems of plausible modeling of the motion of mechanical systems are considered. Physical systems with holonomic and nonholonomic constraints will also be considered. In this paper, variational integrators are considered. This type of integrator is an example of integrators that preserve the geometric structures of a continuous system, and as such they fall into the general class of geometric integration methods. Many long-time integration problems in science and engineering, such as solar system dynamics and molecular dynamics, involve systems that are highly non-linear and sensitive to small perturbations. In the course of the work, a variational approach to the problems of mechanics was considered, the kinematics and dynamics of mechanical systems were described using Lie groups and algebra. The Lie group variational integrator provides a robust and accessible framework for modeling mechanical systems, motion control, trajectory building, and more.

Author Keywords: modeling the dynamics of mechanical systems

articleTitle: Discrete Dynamics of Extremely Multistable Piecewise Chaotic System
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: In this paper we consider the discretization effects appearing in discrete models of the extremely multistable system while simulated by various numerical methods. In our study, we investigate the following set of methods: explicit, implicit, and semi-implicit Euler methods, composition diagonally implicit (CD) methods, explicit and implicit midpoint integrators. We use bifurcation diagrams for highlighting the features of dynamics under investigation introduced by various numerical methods. Significant discrepancies between the nonlinear behavior of discrete models obtained by different integration operators are observed and explained.

articleTitle: The Mandatory State Digital Register of Personal Data Processing Consents
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: In today’s world, data subjects daily express consents to the processing of a variety of personal data, including sensitive data. Consents are expressed both on paper and electronically, e.g., for profiling, targeted advertising, and cross-border transmission. It’s physically difficult for a data subject to control the list of consents he has ever given to specific geographically distributed companies, to consider data processed, processing attributes, and possible risks from the data breach. The article describes the unified state-mandated digital register of personal data processing consents, designed to provide systematic management of consents and data breach risks, discusses the technological structure, the register functionality, ensuring anonymity and security of data contained in the register, integration of the register to legal space of modern states and their unions to protect data subject rights and reduce paper overuse for environmental improvement.

articleTitle: Self-assembly Phenomenon Implementation Problems in Recurrent-Dynamic Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: This paper covers the research of self-assembly phenomenon implementation problems within the recurrent-dynamic approach to the construction of computing architectures. The self-assembly phenomenon that occurs during the nanostructure formation process is approached in relation to the computing systems. An approach to implement the computational process based on this phenomenon has been previously proposed. The recurrent-dynamic approach has been developed as a step towards the implementation of the self-assembly phenomenon. Its main principles are self-sufficient data and recurrence, which are covered within the paper. Based on this approach the prototype of multi-core recurrent data-flow architecture has been developed and a description of its features is provided. An analysis of the existing method for implementing the self-assembly phenomenon within the architecture prototype is also presented. Self-assembly phenomenon implementation issues and their possible solutions are formulated.

articleTitle: Study of Pseudo-Random Number Generators with Feedback Shift Register
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: The object of this article is the development and study of properties of pseudo-random number generators with linear and nonlinear feedback shift registers. Assumptions are made about the retention of periodic properties when switching from linear to nonlinear feedbacks. This article discusses the use of stochastic adders and dynamically evolving substitution blocks in feedback circuit are considered. The statistical properties of generators of different architectures are analyzed. Solutions to improve statistical properties of pseudo-random number generators are proposed.

articleTitle: Data Preprocessing Influence on the Medical Images Segmentation Quality
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: The paper is related to automating computer-tomography image processing. The main task of which is the segmentation of abdominal organs. A typical segmentation pipeline includes the following three stages: image preprocessing, segmentation, and mask post-processing. This article is devoted to the first stage, namely, medical image preprocessing. Generally, research related to medical image segmentation has not paid enough attention to data preprocessing research; usually researchers use conventional preprocessing such as normalization without a deep understanding of the effect on quality. The research is based on the state-of-the-art UNERT neural network and a widely used data set MICCAI 2015 with 30 abdominal clinical CT scans. They consist of 13 labeled abdominal organs in Nifty data format. Different methods of image normalization and preprocessing were investigated from the physical meaning of the Hounsfield scale and from the final quality point of view.

articleTitle: Problems of Training Spiking Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: This article considers such a problem of spiking neural networks as learning. After all, despite the fact that now there are such training methods as Hebbian and STDP, there are still no methods that would provide better performance than second-generation neural networks. Gradient descent, due to the fact that SNN uses differential impulses, cannot be applied to training. Therefore, it is necessary to develop methods for supervised machine learning, which is a challenging task due to the biological realism of networks. Another important problem is the problem of the hardware component. The device must simulate differential equations, and this is a rather time-consuming process.

articleTitle: Application Interface Methods and Structures for Using Natural Language Requests
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: Software developers have to connect various application interface projects in their area of work. One of the challenges during the development phase is understanding the documentation and test requests, the methods of a particular application interface. Sometimes libraries are very difficult to understand, implement and build into a product due to the presence of different structures and logic. In this work, we have analyzed various cloud systems to implement communication between systems and queries through natural language processing. This study proposes approaches to building solutions for using natural language processing for application interfaces and provides a table of general level sentence model templates, as well as tables of projections and conditions of the relationship between the request and the application interface framework. The possibility of creating such an interface for using natural language processing will simplify and improve the development of software that uses the application interface.

articleTitle: Advanced Fog Neural Network Design Method
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: The problem of implementing neural networks on low-performance devices has been considered in many works by various authors around the world. These papers present methods and algorithms for the implementation of neural networks on microcontrollers, FPGAs and other devices. In previous works, method for dividing artificial neural network into block neural network was described, as well as method for synthesizing neural network devices for fog computing. The purpose of this work is to improve the method of synthesizing artificial neural network devices in the direction of increasing the fault tolerance of these devices. The research methodology is based on mathematical modeling of a neural network, circuit modeling of a cascade of neural network devices, analysis of the experimental results for fault tolerance. As a result of the research, we improved neural network devices synthesis method in terms of fault tolerance.

articleTitle: Application of Machine Learning and Parallel Computing to Search for Hypersurfaces Containing Data in Non-Linear Spaces
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: To apply machine learning in practice, you often need to process a large amount of data and this takes a lot of time. The use of parallel computing and other types of parallelism can significantly speed up calculations, sometimes even without changing the algorithm itself. This paper explores the use of machine learning and parallel computing to search for hypersurfaces containing data in non-linear spaces. Since the transfer of data between the CPU and GPU is very speed- limited, it is important to be able to generate geometry directly on the GPU. Using various vertex arrays makes it easy to transfer a large amount of various vertex attributes (such as coordinates, normal/binormal, color, texture coordinates, etc.) directly to the GPU and quickly render data. The main advantages of using CUDA for parallel computing are its simplicity and flexibility.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Renewable Energy Production Forecasting Algorithms Using Python
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: In this paper, forecasting algorithms were tested on renewable energy production data and their comparative analysis was carried outThe machine learning methods that were used in the work are DecisionTree, AdaBoost, RandomForest and LSTM networks.From the analysis of the results of the study, it can be seen that the accuracy of the forecast of the LSTM neural network is higher than all other methods considered, but at the cost of this was the speed of creating a forecast model.Of the considered methods, according to the combination of time and quality criteria, LSTM neural networks turned out to be the best for data analysis, showing the best accuracy. But for SMALL HYDRO and SOLAR data, RandomForest is the preferred method. It made it possible to build sufficiently accurate models in much less time than neural networks.

articleTitle: One Way to Compensate for Missing Values in Datasets
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: Management of complex organizational systems is based on artificial intelligence models such as neural networks, genetic algorithms, and big data analysis techniques for identifying complex patterns. Many real-world datasets may contain missing values for various reasons. Training a model with a dataset that has a lot of missing values can drastically impact the model’s quality. The article considers an approach to missing data recovery based on Chebotarev’s method

articleTitle: Analysis of the Problems of Using VR Technology in Shipbuilding Design
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: The article discusses some of the results of the use of VR technology in the work of design bureaus, presents an analysis of the implementation at certain stages of the ship’s life cycle. The analysis of the engineer’s use of software products for design based on 3D, BIM, Digital Twin is given. Distributed design is taken as the basis for the work of a team of engineers, solutions for remote work are presented. The article also presents the main problems of implementing VR technology in shipbuilding design. The results described in the article will allow us to give a qualitative and quantitative assessment of the use of VR technology directly in the work of an engineer of the design bureau. The presented solutions for distributed design can be used in the organization of work at the enterprise.

articleTitle: Overview of the Accelerated Platform for Robotics and Artificial Intelligence NVIDIA Isaac
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: There are more and more robots in our life: processes are being automated in industry, delivery services are becoming automatic. But, as you know, the development of such robotics for commercial use in industry is very expensive and complicated. Unstructured environments are often used. The accelerated platform for robotics and artificial intelligence NVIDIA Isaac is a comprehensive set of tools for solving these problems, helps to reduce costs, make development easier and present a faster product entry to the market. The NVIDIA Isaac is a framework for robotics that provides the ability to create modular applications. This approach provides high-performance image processing and the use of deep learning technology to create intelligent robots. NVIDIA Isaac announced in 2018 opens a new era of autonomous machines. It is based on Jetson Xavier, a computer designed specifically for robots. This article provides an overview of the NVIDIA Isaac system, its features.

articleTitle: Semantic Text Summarization for Myanmar Language using Word Embedding and Graph Based Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: Text summarization is shortening a set of data computationally, that represents the most important or informative information within the original content. With the increment of information on the internet daily, people are expecting to read documents and texts without having to encounter unnecessary information. Text summarization of other languages have improved, but there are still many challenges for the Myanmar text summarization systems are mainly based on frequencies of words, and these systems are not equivalent in a semantic way. They cannot solve the ambiguity of the Myanmar language. The text has many meanings further the literal meaning of the words. It is very hard for computers to interpret the meaning of the words. Semantic assists in extracting important information from achieving human level understanding from the computers. This paper proposed a semantic Myanmar text summarization system that is mainly based on the integration of the word embedding model and TextRank algorithm for inter-sentence relation. Graphs are everywhere in Natural Language Processing (NLP) and a robust representation of formalism. A graph-based approach for text summarization is an unsupervised technique, is much more comfortable to visualize and is more popular than another summarization. The proposed model accuracy reached an F1 score of 0.6 on average.

articleTitle: Justification of an Experimental Stand Based on a Software-Defined Radio System for Detecting Technical Channels of Information Leakage
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: The work is devoted to the development of a method and means of protecting acoustic information from leakage due to high-frequency irradiation based on SDR technology. One of the dangerous technical channels for leakage of acoustic information from the premises is an active leakage channel created by high-frequency irradiation of semi-active laying devices installed in the room. Based on the results of the system analysis, the requirements for the means of detecting high-frequency radiation signals are justified, the analysis of possible construction schemes is carried out and the block diagram of the means of detecting high-frequency radiation signals is justified. The following is a description of a laboratory stand consisting of an ultrahigh-frequency signal generator, a software-defined radio system, and a laptop on which the software developed by the authors is deployed. The results of experimental studies on the detection of high-frequency radiation signals are presented.

articleTitle: FPGA-implementation of the Decision Block for Numerical Prediction System Based on Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: This paper considers the method of cascading neural network modules to build the operating device of a specialized computing system. Each module implements some model of neural network. The cascade of modules is formed strictly in accordance with the logical links, found after the analysis of training samples. The structure of the input vector is fragmented according to the logical dependencies of the parameter set. Individual nodes of the cascade process certain fragments of the input vector, taking into account the features of neural network models used in them. The library containing the basic elements was prepared in the Quartus II CAD. The prototype with the ensemble of the main modules is implemented on the Cyclone III FPGA. Comparative assessments of the hardware- and software- implementation of the system for predicting numerical results in sports disciplines and multisport competitions are presented.

articleTitle: Determining the Genre of Music from a Melody Using Machine Learning and Parallel Data Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: This article describes the author’s methodology for determining the genre of music from a melody using machine learning and parallel data processing. For determination is used dataset formed by the author, on the basis of which the model is trained and the genre is predicted on the test data. Yandex technologies, parallel programming, and Python data processing models are used in the work. There are also examples of training and test samples, model operation, data cleaning and dataset analysis methods. The work built neural network to identify genres and output results. The results vary from 35% to 50% and it should be noted that the dataset is rather small, so with bigger dataset we can await much higher result.

articleTitle: Data Exchange Acceleration Methods in a Decentralized File System
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: The efficiency of storing and transmitting information in decentralized systems depends on many factors. This article presents methods for accelerating data exchange in a decentralized file system by choosing the optimal file compression algorithm and choosing the optimal server to initialize the connection of a new client. Lossless compression is one of the ways to reduce the load on the channel. In this paper, adaptive compression is considered. This is a special algorithm that, depending on the input data, will adjust the algorithm used to achieve optimal performance in terms of time and compression ratio. To maintain a certain level of quality of service and optimize the use of server resources, it is necessary to adequately predict the workload, assess the current state of the servers, and choose the right balancing strategy. In this article, the ELECTRA IS algorithm is applied to select the optimal server when initializing the connection.

articleTitle: Hyperspectral Technology in State of the Art Computer Vision Application
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: Hyperspectral technology provides the collection and processing of information from various parts of the electromagnetic spectrum. Each object has a unique spectral characteristic of radiation, which makes it possible to uniquely identify the materials that make up its structure. The report discusses the principles of constructing hyperspectral systems, as well as information analysis methods that reduce the dimension of the feature space and solve a wide range of classification problems. Specific examples of the use of hyperspectral systems in practice are given. In particular, medicine, agriculture, archival business.

articleTitle: Methodology for Applying IIoT Architecture to Design IIOT Systems in the Agricultural Sector of the Russian Federation
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: The article presents the results of the study of Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) technologies for the agricultural sector, taking into account international experience for the period 2004 - 2021, and proposes a methodology for applying IIoT architecture to design IIOT systems in the agricultural sector of Russia. A two-factor classification of IIoT systems in agriculture has been made. A typical conceptual scheme of intelligent IIoT system for viticulture and winemaking has been developed. The architecture of a typical IIoT system is analyzed, taking into account the observance of information security in data processing and transmission. An analysis of the current state and prospects for the implementation of IoT in the Russian wine industry has been carried out. A business process model is presented in the concept of BPME (BPM Everywhere) for the production of a certain brand of wine. The model in a non-decomposed form shows sub-processes with and without IoT, using traditional “manual” methods, as well as taking into account the impact of various business processes on production efficiency and product quality. The reasons for the lag and growth drivers for the use of IIoT in agrosector are identified.

articleTitle: Metrics and Indicators of Security of Critical Resources in State and Corporate Objects and Processes
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Information Computing and Processing (ICP)
abstract: The paper comprises development of methods for the formation and analysis of various metrics and numerical indicators for the operational assessment of security of critical resources in their application to state and corporate objects and processes. These methods take into account the structure of these resources, modes and operating conditions. The purpose of the study lies in a mathematical and methodological analysis of metrics and security indicators that can provide reliable and operational security assessments of complex managed information and telecommunications objects and processes.
